title: Seasonal Hiring Readiness Assessment | Hirevue
text:
Peak Hiring Checklist
Is your holiday hiring process ready for peak season?
Answer 12 quick questions to see how prepared your team is to handle peak-season hiring volume — and where bottlenecks may slow you down.
12 questions
4 hiring areas
Complete a short form to view your results.
What you’ll assess
Recruiter Capacity
Manage higher applicant volume
Speed to Hire
Keep qualified candidates moving
Screening & Consistency
Evaluate candidates consistently
Candidate Experience
Make every step easy to complete
Get your readiness score and a clear next step.
